confidence.name: Overall Confidence
confidence.description: Composite weighted score. NOT a security claim — only a progress indicator. Real assurance requires external audit (see Assurance metric).
confidence.formula:
Architecture×20% + Engineering×20% + Avg(SecReadiness, SecAssurance)×15% + Evidence×10% + Operations×20% + Release×15%
Inputs: Arch=95, Eng=20, SecR=90, SecA=0, SecAvg=45.0, Ev=82, Ops=10, Rel=0
Raw = 39.95
